summary: Recorded the monotonic-store measurement in the parent configuration account: receipt e1f5bf19d9fa482380acf68d58ec197e (event 32) shows a commit-tracking store that also reports itself monotonic holding a configuration entry at index 1 and ten commands with the commit index staged at 11, and the node constructed from it returning an empty configuration while its applied index is 11 — so the gap is not an artefact of the store's indexing shape. The account now cites five receipts with joint_history (two cluster runs stating the gap, one monotonic-store run, two repair paths), adds the store-independence point to its counterevidence, and narrows the store limitation to production stores.
